title: Sea Otters Keep a Secret Tool Tucked in Their Armpits
description: Discover how sea otters use rocks as tools, storing them in specialized skin pockets to crack open stubborn prey and protect entire marine ecosystems.
instagram_caption:
Did you know sea otters have a built-in pocket for their favorite rocks? 🦦🪨 This brilliant adaptation helps them crack open hard prey and maintain the balance of our oceans. Watch to see how they use these tools! 

#seaotters #marinelife #naturelovers #wildlifebiology #animaladaptations

segments.narration: A sharp, violent crack echoes across the freezing ocean as a sea otter smashes a rock against a stubborn clam.
broll_queries: close up sea otter cracking clam on chest
sea otter floating on water wide

segments.narration: Floating on its back, the otter places the rock on its chest like an anvil and hammers the prey against it with incredible speed.
broll_queries: close up otter hammering shell on rock
otter floating on back in calm water

segments.narration: Mothers pass this ancient tool-using skill down to their pups, securing a rich meal that ultimately keeps hungry sea urchins from destroying the vital kelp forests.

healthy lush kelp forest underwater wide

segments.narration: These clever marine architects prove that survival requires more than just strength—it takes the perfect tool. Subscribe to The Wild Mechanics for more.
